options.label: Entur (all of Norway), no key needed

fields.name: stop
fields.label: Stop
fields.description: MBTA: the stop or station id from mbta.com/stops (place-pktrm is Park Street). Entur: the stop's name (Jernbanetorget) or its NSR:StopPlace id. TfL: the stop point id (940GZZLUKSX is King's Cross St. Pancras). GTFS-Realtime: the stop_id the feed uses (from the agency's stops.txt), a few with commas. A name of your own goes before an equals sign: Park Street = 70075, 70076.

fields.name: stop2
fields.label: Second stop
fields.description: Optional: another stop, shown beside the first.

fields.name: walk
fields.label: Walk to the stop (minutes)
fields.description: Departures sooner than this are left out: you would not make them.

fields.name: only
fields.label: Only these lines
fields.description: Optional: line names as the board shows them, with commas (Red, 47).

fields.name: feedUrl
fields.label: GTFS-Realtime feed
fields.description: The agency's TripUpdates feed (.pb). The frame downloads it itself and keeps only your stops: any size on FrameOS 2026.11.15 or later; before that, on an ESP32, only a feed under 512 KB.

fields.name: feedHeader
fields.label: Feed header
fields.description: Optional: a header the feed asks for, such as x-api-key: your-key.

transitBoard.name: Transit departures
transitBoard.description: A station board for one or two stops: MBTA, Entur and TfL departures from their own APIs, or any GTFS-Realtime TripUpdates feed decoded on the frame as it streams in. Live and timetable times, delays and cancellations.
